title: RBI Cancels Banking Licence of Paytm Payments Bank Limited
summary: RBI cancels Paytm Payments Bank's license under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, effective April 24, 2026.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Cancels Banking Licence of Paytm Payments Bank Limited. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI cancelled the banking licence issued to **Paytm Payments Bank Limited** under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, prohibiting it from conducting any banking business w.e.f. April 24, 2026.
**Reason**: Persistent non-compliance with licensing conditions and management issues prejudicial to public interest (BR Act Sec 22(3)(c) & (g)).
**Winding Up**: RBI will apply to the High Court for liquidation. Bank has adequate liquidity to repay deposit liabilities.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
